ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Trolls
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Trolls. Frost, cave, armored and anima trolls roam Tamriel, regenerating their wounds unless burned, and their fat brews into regeneration elixirs. Hunt an afflicted troll at its lair, mount its head as a trophy, or carve its likeness.
